description.zh: 帮你读懂政策文件：一页速读（背景、核心内容、适用对象、时间节点）、逐条解读和适用条件自查、影响分析；新旧版本逐条对比并标出数字和字词变化；把政策要求分解成落实任务表，起草贯彻落实方案和申报指引。
description.en: Makes policy documents readable: one-page briefs, clause-by-clause notes, eligibility checks, impact analysis, old-vs-new comparisons with highlighted changes, implementation task lists, plans, and filing guides.

welcome_message.zh: 把政策文件发给我，告诉我你是政府部门、企业还是个人
welcome_message.en: Send me the policy document and tell me if you're an agency, a company, or an individual

prompt.zh: 我上传了 ___，帮我做一页速读，我的身份是 ___。
prompt.en: I uploaded ___. Give me a one-page brief. I am a ___.

prompt.zh: 根据这份政策，我们 ___（企业情况）能不能享受 ___？帮我逐项核对条件。
prompt.en: Based on this policy, can we (___) get ___? Check each condition.

description.en: What changed and why it matters

prompt.zh: 对比 ___（旧版）和 ___（新版），列出变化并说明对 ___ 的影响。
prompt.en: Compare ___ (old) and ___ (new), list the changes and their impact on ___.

prompt.zh: 把这份文件的要求分解成我单位的落实任务表，我们的部门有：___。
prompt.en: Break this document into an implementation task list for our departments: ___.

prompt.zh: 根据这份政策和配套通知，帮我整理一份申报指引：
prompt.en: Write a filing guide from this policy and its notice:
About this policy, my question is: ___

zh: 每周一「09:00」检查 inbound 目录新上传的政策文件，生成一页速读
每月 1 日「10:00」整理本单位正在落实的政策任务进度，列出临近时限的任务
每次收到新版政策后，自动与旧版对比并列出变化
每季度第一个工作日「10:00」梳理即将到期或进入申报期的政策
每周五「16:00」汇总本周解读的政策和待向主管部门确认的问题
每年 12 月 1 日「09:00」整理本年度已享受和可申报的政策清单
en: Every Monday at 09:00, write one-page briefs for new policy files in inbound
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, report progress on policy tasks and flag near deadlines
Whenever a new version arrives, compare it with the old one and list the changes
On the first weekday of each quarter at 10:00, list policies expiring or opening for applications
Every Friday at 16:00, summarize this week's policies and open questions for authorities
On December 1 each year at 09:00, list policies used this year and those still available
